A con man and [[Starship/Legends|ship]] booster, '''Dozer Creed''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was recruited by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] to help [[Marblewood Estate heist|break]] into [[Avrak Villachor]]'s vault.<ref name="Scoundrels" />
